title: I built an AI-powered D&D-style game where the world reacts to your every choice – would love your feedback!
author: Obreira22

comments.author: endege
comments.body:
There's something that I find really annoying, the Combat box. If, the quest throws me in combat, the combat box is not visible and I have to scroll up to click Attack every single time. A suggestion would be to move the combat box on the left side under the Stats. That would fix this issue.

The second issue is that it doesn't really seem to follow the prompt. I tell it to look around the Cathedral and it takes me outside of the city. I tell it to go deeper into the woods multiple times and it kind of repeats the same things and even telling me stuff like "As you step away from the bustling Marketplace" when I was outside the city for like 5-6 prompts before. Not sure what LLM you are using but it sure doesn't seem to be able to follow prompts or the instructions sent to it are not accurate enough. I had a lot of problems with my AI flows while building my AI roleplay platform [https://soulweaverai.com/](https://soulweaverai.com/)

comments.author: PhaseConsistent3844
comments.body:
It is starting to feel like everyone on this SubR and their cousins are all building their Ai DND, its clearly an interesting space... and there's potential. But most apps out there are protos/look bad and often play pretty bad too.   
Would be interesting to see who's interested in not building on their own the same thing as all the others... but actually get connected and build a more ambitious vision. Maybe if there's enough comments or upV, i'll get a thread on that. 

there's also stuff to build from out there arguably (such as SillyTavern and Kobold) . 

Not saying your thing's bad btw. But i'd advise to give a taster rather than just a link where you got signup to know what's even in your thing. It's not likely to yield much conversion to play if you put barriers from the start.

IMHO

replies.author: Obreira22
replies.body:
Well I agree with you. But what I played didn’t feel like it was to my liking. So I made one with what I think lacked on the others. Your right there a cooler things that can be made with this idea. 
The signup is only there so you or any other person can have their costume games saved nothing else. I don’t even ask for any type of info.

replies.author: Obreira22

replies.author: Leading_Ad_5166
replies.body: One more question.  I didn't have to put in my own API key, so i'm assuming you're using your own.  Does the cost add up from many people prompting your subscriptions?

replies.author: Obreira22
